items.slavonic_diplomatic: Сла́ва: Страстьми́ мѧ преклоне́на ѿ сопроти́вныхъ прилѡ́гъ, Ма́ти Бж҃їа, оу҆твердѝ, ꙗ҆́же безстра́стїа ро́ждшаѧ и҆сто́чникъ; къ тебѣ́ бо прибѣго́хъ, ѻ҆каѧ́нныѧ моеѧ̀ душѝ оу҆тѣ́шительницѣ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Glory...* Strengthen me who am bent down by passions through the assaults of adversaries, O Mother of God, who didst bear the Fountain of impassibility; for unto thee have I fled, the comforter of my wretched soul.[^7035]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: И҆ ны́нѣ: При́зри Влады́чице на мѧ̀ смире́ннаго, и҆ ненаде́жднѡ спаси́ мѧ; ты́ бо є҆сѝ оу҆пова́нїе и҆ покро́въ мо́й, жи́знь и҆ свѣ́тъ се́рдцу моемꙋ̀ Бцⷣе, и҆ оу҆твержде́нїе.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Both now...* Look down, O Sovereign Lady, upon me, the humble one, and beyond hope save me; for thou art my hope and protection, life and light unto my heart, O Mother of God, and my establishment.[^7036]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Сѣда́ленъ, Гла́съ ѕ҃. Безпомо́щнымъ крѣ́пость, ты̀ вои́стинꙋ пресвѧта́ѧ Дѣ́во Ма́ти: ѿсю́ду смире́ннїи тобо́ю возвыша́емсѧ, ѡ҆ тебѣ̀ высо́цѣ держи́мсѧ; всѣ̑мъ ты́ є҆сѝ покро́въ, и҆ къ Бг҃у хода́таица.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Sessional Hymn, Tone 6:* Thou art truly the strength of the helpless, O all-holy Virgin Mother; therefore we the humble are lifted up through thee and held high in thee: thou art the protection of all and intercessor before God.[^7037]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: И҆ ны́нѣ: Молѧ́щи не преста́й человѣколю́бца Бг҃а на́шего, Всенепоро́чнаѧ, ꙗ҆́ко да прїи́мемъ соверше́нное проще́нїе Чи́стаѧ: и҆ оу҆лучи́мъ небе́сныхъ оу҆гото́ваныхъ бла̑гъ, и҆ неѿе́млемую ра́дость.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Both now...* Cease not to entreat God our Lover of mankind, O All-Immaculate One, that we may receive perfect forgiveness, O Pure One, and attain the prepared heavenly good things and joy that cannot be taken away.[^7042]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Сла́ва: Къ твоему̀ прибѣга́ю покро́ву Всенепоро́чнаѧ, и҆ предста́телницу живота̀ моегѡ̀ тѧ̀ ны́нѣ предлага́ю: и҆зба́ви мѧ̀ Ѻ҆трокови́це, сꙋда̀ стра́шнагѡ, и҆ и҆спыта́нїа, и҆ ѻ҆гнѧ̀ вѣ́чнагѡ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Glory...* I flee unto thy protection, O All-Immaculate One, and now set thee forth as the defender of my life: deliver me, O Maiden, from the dread judgment, and the trial, and the eternal fire.[^7046]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Сла́ва: Чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во бг҃ообра́дованнаѧ, две́ре свѣ́та, две́ри дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ ѿве́рзи, грѣха̀ вхо́дъ заключа́ющи: да мѧ̀ не пріи́метъ рꙋка̀ льсти́вагѡ, ведꙋ́щи лю́тѣ къ всепа́гꙋбнѣй и стра́шнѣй мꙋ́цѣ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Glory...* O pure Virgin made glad of God, gate of light: open the doors of my soul, shutting fast the entrance of sin, that the hand of the crafty one may not lay hold of me, leading me grievously unto all-destructive and dread torment.[^7051]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: И҆ ны́нѣ: Дꙋшѐ, возни́кни и побдѝ въ моли́твахъ и въ всеблаги́хъ попече́ніихъ, оуны́ніѧ со́нъ ѿгонѧ́ющи, бо́дрꙋю застꙋ́пницꙋ имꙋ́щи всегда̀, чи́стꙋю Ма́терь Бж҃ію всеще́дрꙋю.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Both now...* Awaken, O my soul, and watch in prayers and in all-good cares, driving away the sleep of despondency, having ever as a vigilant intercessor the pure and all-merciful Mother of God.[^7052]

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the First Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 6:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Помышлѧ́ю де́нь стра́шный, и҆ пла́чꙋсѧ дѣѧ́ній мои́хъ лꙋка́выхъ: ка́кѡ ѿвѣща́ю безсме́ртномꙋ Царю̀? ко́имъ же дерзнове́ніемъ воззрю̀ на Сꙋді́ю, блꙋ́дный а҆́зъ? Благоꙋтро́бный Оу҆́тче, Сы́не є҆диноро́дный, и҆ Дꙋ́ше ст҃ый, поми́лꙋй мѧ̀.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Sessional Hymn 1:* I meditate upon the dread day, and weep over my wicked deeds: How shall I answer the immortal King? And with what boldness shall I, a prodigal, look upon the Judge? O Compassionate Father, Only-begotten Son, and Holy Spirit, have mercy upon me.[^7054]

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the First Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 6:*
items.preceding_stichos: Verse: O Lord, rebuke me not in Thine anger, nor chasten me in Thy wrath.*[^7055]
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Въ ю҆до́ли плаче́внѣй, на мѣ́стѣ и҆́деже положѝ, є҆гда̀ сѧ́деши Ми́лостиве сотвори́ти пра́ведный сꙋ́дъ, не ѡ҆бличѝ моѧ̑ сокрове́ннаѧ, нижѐ посрамѝ менѐ пред̾ А҆́гг҃лы: но пощади́ мѧ Бж҃е, и҆ поми́лꙋй мѧ̀.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Sessional Hymn 2:* In the valley of weeping, in the place which Thou hast appointed, when Thou, O Merciful One, sittest to execute righteous judgment, expose not my hidden deeds, neither put me to shame before the Angels; but spare me, O God, and have mercy upon me.[^7056]

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the First Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 6:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Сла́ва: и҆ ны́нѣ: Бг҃оро́диченъ. Милосе́рдіѧ две́ри ѿве́рзи на́мъ благослове́ннаѧ Бцⷣе Дѣ́во, надѣ́ющіисѧ на тѧ̀ да непоги́бнемъ, но да и҆зба́вимся тобо́ю ѿ бѣ́дъ; ты́ бо є҆сѝ спасе́ніе ро́да Хрⷭ҇тіа́нскагѡ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Glory... both now... Theotokion:* Open the doors of tender mercy unto us, O blessed Virgin Theotokos, that we who hope in thee may not perish, but may be delivered through thee from tribulations; for thou art the salvation of the Christian race.[^7057]

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Second Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 6:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Дꙋшѐ моѧ̀, вскꙋ́ю оу҆ныва́ющи грѣхꙋ̀ рабо́таеши? и҆ вскꙋ́ю бола́ющи, къ врачꙋ̀ не прихо́диши? Возни́кни про́чее ѿ ѕѡ́лъ, ꙗ҆́же содѣ́лала є҆сѝ, и҆ возопі́й къ Спа́сꙋ глаго́лющи: наде́жде ненаде́жднымъ, животѐ ѿча́нныхъ Спа́се, воздви́гни, и҆ спаси́ мѧ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Sessional Hymn 1:* O my soul, why dost thou in despondency serve sin? And why being sick dost thou not come unto the Physician? Arise henceforth from the evil things which thou hast committed, and cry aloud unto the Savior, saying: O Hope of the hopeless, Life of the despaired, O Savior, raise me up and save me.[^7058]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Мꙋ́дрыхъ дѣ́въ да́рꙋй мнѣ̀ Гдⷭ҇и бдѣ́ніе, и҆ дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ свѣщꙋ̀ просвѣтѝ є҆ле́емъ щедро́тъ твои́хъ, да пѣ́снь А҆́гг҃льскꙋю пою̀ тебѣ̀: А҆ллилꙋ́іа.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Sessional Hymn 2:* Grant me, O Lord, the vigilance of the wise virgins, and enlighten the lamp of my soul with the oil of Thy compassions, that I may sing the Angelic song unto Thee: Alleluia.[^7060]

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Second Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 6:*
items.preceding_stichos: Verse: God is marvelous in His saints, the God of Israel.*[^7061]
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Страстоте́рпческій по́двигъ претерпѣ́вше Ст҃і́и, по́чести побѣ́ды ѿ тебѐ пріѧ́ша; оу҆праздни́ша помышле́ніѧ беззако́нныхъ, и҆ воспріѧ́ша вѣнцы̀ нетлѣ̑нныѧ. Тѣ́хъ ра́ди Бж҃е оу҆моле́нъ бы́въ, да́рꙋй на́мъ ве́лію ми́лость.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Martyrikon:* Having endured the passion-bearing struggle, O Saints, they received from Thee the honors of victory; they brought to nought the devices of the lawless, and received incorruptible crowns. Being entreated for their sake, O God, grant us great mercy.[^7062]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Сла́ва: И҆ ны́нѣ: Бг҃оро́диченъ. Оу҆пова́ніе мі́ра, блага́ѧ Бцⷣе Дѣ́во, твоѐ и҆ є҆ди́ное стра́шное предста́тельство про́симъ: оу҆милосе́рдисѧ на лю́ди безпомо́щныѧ; молѝ ми́лостиваго Бг҃а, и҆зба́витисѧ дꙋша́мъ на́шымъ ѿ всѧ́кагѡ преще́ніѧ, є҆ди́на Благослове́ннаѧ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Glory... both now... Theotokion:* O Hope of the world, good Virgin Theotokos, we ask thine and only dread intercession: Have compassion upon a helpless people; entreat the merciful God that our souls may be delivered from every threatening, O only Blessed One.[^7063]

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 6:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Живота̀ ꙗ҆́кѡ показа́лъ є҆сѝ пꙋтѝ лю́демъ І҆ѡа́нне, вопіѧ̀: и҆спра́вите сердца̀ ва́ша Гдⷭ҇еви; спасѝ многогрѣ́шнꙋю мою̀ дꙋ́шꙋ, къ оу҆миле́нію приведѝ ѡ҆камене́ннꙋю мы́сль, и҆ и҆зба́ви бꙋ́дꙋщїѧ мꙋ́ки твои́ми моли́твами, Предте́че Спа́совъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Sessional Hymn 1:* As thou didst show unto the people the ways of life, O John, crying aloud: "Make straight your hearts for the Lord"; save my most sinful soul, lead unto compunction my petrified mind, and deliver me from future torment by thy prayers, O Forerunner of the Savior.[^7064]

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 6:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Страсте́й мѧ̀ бꙋ́рѧ, и҆ лю́тое треволне́ніе прегрѣше́ній, въ ѿча́ѧніѧ глꙋбинѣ̀ потопѝ, Сло́ве: но простри́ мнѣ̀ держа́внꙋю твою̀ десни́цꙋ, и҆ спаси́ мѧ ꙗ҆́кѡже Петра̀, свѧще́нными моли́твами Предте́чи твоегѡ̀, и҆зъ глꙋбины̀ ѕлолю́тыхъ беззако́ній мои́хъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Sessional Hymn 2:* The storm of passions and the fierce surging of transgressions have drowned me in the depth of despair, O Word; but stretch forth unto me Thy mighty right hand, and save me as Thou didst Peter, by the sacred prayers of Thy Forerunner, from the depth of my fiercely wicked iniquities.[^7065]

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 6:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Сла́ва: и҆ ны́нѣ: Бг҃оро́диченъ. И҆́же пре́жде вѣ̑къ ѿ Оу҆ц҃а̀ безъ ма́тере, ро́ждшагосѧ Сы́на и҆ Сло́ва Бж҃іа, въ послѣ̑днѧѧ лѣ̑та родила̀ є҆сѝ воплоще́нна ѿ чи́стыхъ крове́й твои́хъ Благороди́тельнице, кромѣ̀ мꙋ́жа; є҆го́же молѝ, дарова́ти на́мъ грѣхѡ́въ проще́ніе пре́жде конца̀.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Glory... both now... Theotokion:* Him Who before the ages was begotten of the Father without a mother, the Son and Word of God, in these latter times hast thou, O Birthgiver of Good, brought forth incarnate from thy pure blood without a man; Him do thou entreat, to grant us forgiveness of sins before the end.[^7066]

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Penitential Canon to our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the Holy Martyrs. By Lord Joseph. Tone 6. Ode 1. Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Помо́щникъ и҆ покрови́тель бы́сть мнѣ̀ во спасе́ніе, се́й мо́й Бг҃ъ, и҆ просла́влю є҆го̀; Бг҃ъ ѻ҆тца̀ моегѡ̀, и҆ вознесꙋ̀ є҆го̀: сла́внѡ бо просла́висѧ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Heirmos:* He was unto me a helper and protector for salvation; this is my God, and I will glorify Him; the God of my father, and I will exalt Him: for gloriously hath He been glorified.[^7067]

items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion 1:* O my Redeemer Jesus, as Thou didst once redeem from many transgressions the harlot who repented well, I pray Thee: deliver me also from my countless evils, as Thou art merciful.[^7068]

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Penitential Canon to our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the Holy Martyrs. By Lord Joseph. Tone 6. Ode 1. Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: И҆зба́вителю мо́й І҆и҃се, ꙗ҆́кѡже и҆зба́вилъ є҆сѝ мно́гихъ прегрѣше́ній блꙋдни́цꙋ и҆ногда̀, пока́ѧвшꙋюсѧ до́брѣ, молю́сѧ тебѣ̀: и҆ менѐ и҆зба́ви безчи́сленныхъ ѕѡ́лъ мои́хъ, ꙗ҆́кѡ ми́лостивъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion 2:* Sailing through this fierce deep in the vain contemplation of life, O Jesus, I have fallen into many drownings; deliver me from them and save me.[^7069]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Препла́ваѧ въ сꙋ́етнѣмъ помышле́ніи житіа̀, І҆и҃се, лю́тꙋю сію̀ пꙋчи́нꙋ, въ и҆стопле́ніѧ впадо́хъ мнѡ́гаѧ; ѿ ни́хже и҆зба́вивъ спаси́ мѧ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Martyrikon:* Let us joyfully honor the valiant sufferers, the destroyers of the alien, who patiently suffered and received from God the crowns of victory.[^7070]

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Penitential Canon to our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the Holy Martyrs. By Lord Joseph. Tone 6. Ode 1. Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Мꙋ́чениченъ. До́блественныѧ страда́льцы, чꙋжда́гѡ потреби́тели, терпѣли́внѡ пострада́вшіѧ, и҆ вѣнцы̀ пріи́мшіѧ ѿ Бг҃а побѣ̑дныѧ, ра́достнѡ почти́мъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Martyrikon:* Speaking with wisdom through the boldness of God the Word, [ye overcame] the evil rhetors ye overcame, O wise ones; and having endured every kind of wound, ye were exceedingly glorified.[^7071]

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Penitential Canon to our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the Holy Martyrs. By Lord Joseph. Tone 6. Ode 1. Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: А҆́гглъ бж҃твенный твоѐ рождество̀, А҆́ггле Бж҃ій, предвозвѣща́етъ ѻ҆тцꙋ̀; съ ни́мже на́съ поманѝ, є҆́же въ де́нь сꙋ́дный ѡ҆брѣстѝ на́мъ ми́лость, ст҃ы́й Предте́че.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion 1:* A divine Angel foretold thy birth unto thy father, O Angel of God; together with him remember us, that we may find mercy in the day of judgment, O holy Forerunner.[^7074]

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Penitential Canon to our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the Holy Martyrs. By Lord Joseph. Tone 6. Ode 1. Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Произзябе́ніе сы́й кра́сное пꙋсты́нное, Предте́че Хрⷭ҇то́въ, въ мнѣ̀ непреста́ннѡ произзѧба́ющꙋю лѣ́ность и҆зъ ко́рене и҆сто́ргнꙋвъ, покаѧ́ніѧ мѧ̀ приноси́ти плоды̀ сотворѝ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion 2:* Being a fair offshoot of the wilderness, O Forerunner of Christ, uproot from the core the slothfulness that unceasingly shoots up in me, and make me bring forth fruits of repentance.[^7075]

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Penitential Canon to our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the Holy Martyrs. By Lord Joseph. Tone 6. Ode 1. Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Оу҆тро́ба безча́дна тѧ̀ пло́дъ ражда́етъ пресла́внѡ, благопло́днаѧ сердца̀, ꙗ҆́же пре́жде непло́днаѧ показа́вшаѧ, но вѣ́рою вопію̀ тебѣ̀ Крести́телю: непло́днаѧ моѧ̑ помышле́ніѧ и҆сто́ргни.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion 3:* A barren womb most gloriously brought thee forth as fruit, making fruitful the hearts that before were unfruitful; but in faith I cry unto thee, O Baptist: Uproot my fruitless thoughts.[^7076]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Бг҃оро́диченъ. Ле́стію непреста́ннѡ, вра́гъ лови́тъ мѧ̀ лꙋка́вый; тогѡ́ мѧ ловле́ніѧ Всенепоро́чнаѧ и҆схитѝ, и҆ твори́ти Бцⷣе наста́ви Влады́чню бж҃твеннꙋю во́лю.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Theotokion:* By deceit the crafty enemy unceasingly hunts me; snatch me from his snaring, O All-Immaculate One, and guide me, O Theotokos, to do the Master's divine will.[^7077]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ми́лостивнымъ твои́мъ ѻ҆́комъ при́зри на мѧ̀, є҆гда̀ хощꙋ̀ предъ тобо́ю предста́ти и҆ сꙋди́тисѧ, є҆ди́не благопремѣ́нителю Гдⷭ҇и.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Воздыха́юща мѧ̀ пріимѝ, ꙗ҆́кѡже Мытарѧ̀, и҆зъ глꙋбины̀ дꙋше́вныѧ; и҆ покаѧ́ніе мнѣ̀ да́рꙋй Спа́се, грѣха̀ всѧ́кагѡ мѧ̀ и҆збавлѧ́ющее.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Бг҃оро́диченъ. Зачала̀ є҆сѝ, Прест҃а́ѧ, Содержа́щаго ве́сь мі́ръ; сегѡ̀ ра́ди молю́сѧ тебѣ̀: и҆зба́ви мѧ всѧ́кагѡ содержа́щагѡ мꙋче́ніа.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Theotokion:* Thou didst conceive, O Most Holy One, Him Who holds the whole world; therefore I pray thee: Deliver me from every torment that holds me fast.[^7083]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Кан: Предте́чи. І҆рмо́съ, На тве́рдѣмъ вѣ́ры твоеѧ̀ ка́мени, помышле́ніе ѡ҆снова́въ дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀, оу҆твердѝ Гдⷭ҇и: тѧ́ бо и҆́мамъ Бла́же, прибѣ́жище и҆ оу҆твержде́ніе.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ѡ҆браще́ніе ѿ пꙋтѝ заблꙋ́ждшемꙋ да́ждь мнѣ̀ ны́нѣ, и҆ простри́ мнѣ̀ рꙋ́кꙋ, блаже́нне Предте́че, въ пꙋчи́нѣ лю́тыхъ всегда̀ пла́вающемꙋ.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Penitential Canon to our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the Holy Martyrs. By Lord Joseph. Tone 6. Ode 1. Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Живꙋ̀ лѣ́ностнѡ, и҆ посѣче́ніе приближа́етсѧ; твои́ми моли́твами возникнове́ніе мнѣ̀ да́ждь, присносла́вный Предте́че, да не ꙗ҆́кѡ безпло́денъ ѿсла́нъ бꙋ́дꙋ въ ѻ҆́гнь неꙋгаси́мый.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion 2:* I live slothfully, and the cutting down draws near; by thy prayers grant me revival, O ever-glorious Forerunner, that I may not be sent into the unquenchable fire as unfruitful.[^7086]

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Penitential Canon to our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the Holy Martyrs. By Lord Joseph. Tone 6. Ode 1. Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Стра́шный де́нь при две́рехъ, а҆́зъ же лю́тыми ѡ҆бложе́нъ є҆́смь бре́менми; ѿ ни́хже мѧ ѡ҆блегчѝ Гдⷭ҇не Крести́телю, чи́стыми твои́ми мольба́ми.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion 3:* The dread day is at the doors, and I am compassed about with grievous burdens; relieve me from them, O Baptist of the Lord, by thy pure supplications.[^7087]

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Penitential Canon to our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the Holy Martyrs. By Lord Joseph. Tone 6. Ode 1. Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Бг҃оро́диченъ. Престо́лъ Бж҃ій ꙗ҆ви́ласѧ є҆сѝ Бцⷣе, на не́мже пло́тію сѣ́дый Хрⷭ҇то́съ, ѿ пе́рвагѡ паде́ніа человѣ́ки воздви́же, въ гла́сѣхъ ра́достныхъ пою́щїа тѧ̀.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Theotokion:* Thou wast shown forth as the throne of God, O Theotokos, whereon Christ, sitting in the flesh, raised up men from the first fall, who sing unto thee with joyful voices.[^7088]

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Penitential Canon to our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the Holy Martyrs. By Lord Joseph. Tone 6. Ode 1. Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Оу҆слы́ша проро́къ прише́ствїе твоѐ Гдⷭ҇и, и҆ оу҆боѧ́сѧ, ꙗ҆́ко хо́щеши ѿ Дѣ́вы роди́тисѧ, и҆ человѣ́кѡмъ ꙗ҆ви́тисѧ, и҆ глаго́лаше: оу҆слы́шахъ слꙋ́хъ тво́й, и҆ оу҆боѧ́хсѧ; сла́ва си́лѣ твое́й Гдⷭ҇и.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Tone 6. Ode 4. Heirmos:* The Prophet heard of Thy coming, O Lord, and was afraid, that Thou wast about to be born of a Virgin and appear unto men, and he said: I heard report of Thee and was afraid; glory to Thy power, O Lord.[^7089]

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Penitential Canon to our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the Holy Martyrs. By Lord Joseph. Tone 6. Ode 1. Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: То́ки сле́зъ да́ждь мнѣ̀ и҆зсꙋша́ющїа страсте́й мои́хъ и҆сто́чники, и҆ грѣха̀ всѧ́кое тимѣ́ніе ѿмыва́ющїа, Ще́дре многоми́лостиве, и҆ оу҆гаша́ющїа ѻ҆гнѧ̀ гее́нскагѡ вѣчнꙋющій пла́мень неꙋгаси́мый.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion 1:* Grant me streams of tears drying up the fountains of my passions, and washing away all mire of sin, O Compassionate and Plenteous in mercy, and quenching the eternal, unquenchable flame of Gehenna's fire.[^7090]

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Penitential Canon to our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the Holy Martyrs. By Lord Joseph. Tone 6. Ode 1. Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Непреста́ннѡ чешꙋ̀ стро́пы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ сластолю́біемъ, и҆ пребыва́ю неисцѣ́ленъ, въ чꙋ́вство са́мъ пріитѝ не хотѧ̀. Что̀ бꙋ́дꙋ? и҆ что̀ сотворю̀? Хрⷭ҇тѐ ще́дрый, и҆сцѣли́въ спаси́ мѧ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion 2:* Unceasingly I scratch the sores of my soul with love of pleasure, and remain unhealed, not willing myself to come to my senses. What will become of me? And what shall I do? O compassionate Christ, heal and save me.[^7091]

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Penitential Canon to our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the Holy Martyrs. By Lord Joseph. Tone 6. Ode 1. Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Мꙋ́чениченъ. Во́дъ поги́бельныхъ, и҆ бꙋ́ри ѕло́бныѧ, ѡ҆кормле́ніемъ бж҃е́ственнымъ, Мꙋ́ченици присноблаже́ннїи, вѣ́рою преплы́вше пꙋчи́нꙋ непостоѧ́ннꙋю, въ безбѣ́дное и҆ небꙋ́рное ца́рствіа небе́снагѡ приста́нище доспѣ́сте.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Martyrikon:* Having by divine governance through faith sailed across the unstable deep of destructive waters and the storm of malice, O ever-blessed Martyrs, ye reached the distress-free and stormless haven of the heavenly Kingdom.[^7092]

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Penitential Canon to our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the Holy Martyrs. By Lord Joseph. Tone 6. Ode 1. Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Просвѣти́тницы благоче́стїа, свѣти̑ла и҆́стины бы́вше, свѣ́томъ по́двигѡвъ потреби́сте тмꙋ̀ безбо́жіа многоболѣ́зненнꙋю; чꙋде́съ же зарѧ́ми, Мꙋ́ченници, страсте́й мгнꙋ̀ разгонѧ́ете.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Martyrikon:* Having become illuminators of piety and luminaries of truth, by the light of your struggles ye destroyed the grievous darkness of godlessness; and by the rays of miracles, O Martyrs ye dispel the mist of passions.[^7093]

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Penitential Canon to our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the Holy Martyrs. By Lord Joseph. Tone 6. Ode 1. Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Бг҃оро́диченъ. Седмосвѣ́тлый тѧ̀ свѣ́щникъ, ѻ҆́гнь бг҃оразꙋ́міа носѧ́щъ ѻ҆трокови́це, дре́вле прови́дѣ, свѣтѧ́щїй въ тмѣ̀ невѣ́дѣніа бѣ́дствꙋющимъ; тѣ́мже вопію̀ тебѣ̀ Всенепоро́чнаѧ: просвѣти́ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Theotokion:* Of old [the Prophet] foresaw thee, O Maiden, as a seven-branched lampstand bearing the fire of the knowledge of God, shining upon those who are in distress in the darkness of ignorance; therefore I cry unto thee, O All-Immaculate One: Enlighten me, I pray.[^7094]

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Penitential Canon to our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the Holy Martyrs. By Lord Joseph. Tone 6. Ode 1. Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Оу҆слы́шахъ слꙋ́хъ тво́й, и҆ оу҆боѧ́хсѧ; разꙋмѣ́хъ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, и҆ оу҆жасо́хсѧ. Сла́ва си́лѣ твое́й Гдⷭ҇и.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Canon to the Forerunner. Heirmos:* I heard report of Thee and was afraid; I understood Thy works and was in dread. Glory to Thy power, O Lord.[^7095]

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Penitential Canon to our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the Holy Martyrs. By Lord Joseph. Tone 6. Ode 1. Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Оу҆врачꙋ́й Предте́че, оу҆ѧ́звленое на пꙋте́хъ разбо́йническихъ се́рдце моѐ, молю́сѧ тебѣ̀, дѣ́тельною бж҃твенныхъ твои́хъ моли́твъ цѣльбо́ю.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion 1:* Heal my heart wounded upon the robbers' paths, I pray thee, O Forerunner, by the effective medicine of thy divine prayers.[^7096]

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Penitential Canon to our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the Holy Martyrs. By Lord Joseph. Tone 6. Ode 1. Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Низложѝ Предте́че, є҆щѐ живꙋ́щій въ дꙋшѝ мое́й грѣ́хъ; и҆ возникнове́ніе ны́нѣ да́рꙋй мнѣ̀, къ сласте́мъ пополза́ющемꙋсѧ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion 2:* Cast down, O Forerunner, the sin that yet lives in my soul; and grant revival now unto me who slip towards pleasures.[^7097]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Приста́нище на́мъ ꙗ҆ви́сѧ ѡ҆бꙋрева́ємымъ въ пꙋчи́нѣ жите́йскїа бꙋ́ри; преложѝ всѣ́хъ въ тишинꙋ̀, Пребога́те.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion 3:* Be shown forth as a haven unto us who are tempest-tossed in the deep of the storm of life; bring all unto calm, O Exceedingly Rich One.[^7098]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Бг҃оро́диченъ. Да не ѡ҆сꙋ́диши менѐ Гдⷭ҇и по дѣлѡ́мъ мои̑мъ, но ми́лостивъ мнѣ̀ ꙗ҆ви́сѧ Всеще́дрый: мо́литъ тѧ съ Крⷭ҇ти́телемъ, Ро́ждшаѧ тѧ̀.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Theotokion:* Condemn me not, O Lord, according to my deeds, but show Thyself merciful unto me, O All-Merciful One: She that bare Thee entreats Thee together with the Baptist.[^7099]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Пѣ́снь є҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ѿ но́щи оу҆́тренююща, Человѣколю́бче, просвѣтѝ, молю́сѧ, и҆ наста́ви менѐ на повелѣ́нїа твоѧ̑, и҆ наꙋчи́ мѧ Спа́се твори́ти во́лю твою̀.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Penitential Canon to our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the Holy Martyrs. By Lord Joseph. Tone 6. Ode 1. Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Сѐ, и҆́же тала́нтъ тво́й скры́вый, Хрⷭ҇тѐ, лѣни́вый ра́бъ тво́й и҆ оу҆праздни́выйсѧ лꙋка́выми страсте́й дѣѧ́ніи, а҆́зъ є҆́смь; тѣ́мже не посла́й менѐ въ ѻ҆́гнь.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion 1:* Behold, I am he that hid Thy talent, O Christ, Thy slothful servant who have been made idle by the wicked deeds of passions; therefore send me not into the fire.[^7101]

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Penitential Canon to our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the Holy Martyrs. By Lord Joseph. Tone 6. Ode 1. Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Тво́й сы́нъ бы́въ благода́тію, благоꙋтро́бне Хрⷭ҇тѐ, порабо́тихсѧ врагꙋ̀, и҆ ѿ тебѐ оу҆дали́хсѧ жи́въ блꙋ́днѡ; тѣ́мже ѡ҆брати́въ мѧ, спасѝ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion 2:* Having been Thy son by grace, O compassionate Christ, I became enslaved unto the enemy, and removed myself from Thee by living prodigally; therefore turn me back and save me.[^7102]

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Penitential Canon to our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the Holy Martyrs. By Lord Joseph. Tone 6. Ode 1. Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Мꙋ́чениченъ. Мꙋ́ченици стоѧ́хꙋ предъ сꙋди́щемъ, щи́тъ вѣ́ры ѡ҆бносѧ́ще; тѣ́мже стрѣ́лами ле́стными оу҆ѧзви́ти, тѣ́хъ лю́тый ѿстꙋ́пникъ не возмо́же.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Martyrikon:* The Martyrs stood before the judgment seat, bearing about the shield of faith; therefore with deceitful arrows the fierce apostate was unable to wound them.[^7103]

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Penitential Canon to our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the Holy Martyrs. By Lord Joseph. Tone 6. Ode 1. Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Мꙋ́чениченъ. Оу҆мерщвлѧ́еми тѣ́лами Мꙋ́ченици, всѧ̑ оу҆мертви́ша ко́зни вра́жіѧ: и҆ къ жи́зни неста́рѣющейсѧ преидо́ша въ ра́дости, вѣнцы̀ побѣ́ды пріи́мше.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Martyrikon:* Being put to death in body, the Martyrs put to death all the wiles of the enemy, and passed over in joy unto life that grows not old, having received the crowns of victory.[^7104]

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Penitential Canon to our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the Holy Martyrs. By Lord Joseph. Tone 6. Ode 1. Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Бг҃оро́диченъ. Врата̀ непроходи́маѧ! ѿве́рзи мнѣ̀ врата̀, молю́сѧ, покаѧ́ніа и҆́стиннагѡ; и҆ покажи́ мнѣ̀ стезю̀ покаѧ́ніа Чи́стаѧ, всѣ́хъ наста́внице.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Theotokion:* O impassable gate! Open unto me, I pray, the gates of true repentance; and show me the path of repentance, O Pure One, guide of all.[^7105]

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Penitential Canon to our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the Holy Martyrs. By Lord Joseph. Tone 6. Ode 1. Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Къ тебѣ̀ оу҆́тренюю, милосе́рдіѧ ра́ди себѐ и҆стощи́вшемꙋ непрело́жнѡ, и҆ до страсте́й безстра́стнѡ прекло́ншемꙋсѧ Сло́ве Бж҃ій, ми́ръ пода́ждь мнѣ̀ па́дшемꙋ, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Canon to the Forerunner. Heirmos:* Early I rise unto Thee, O Word of God, Who for mercy's sake didst unchangeably empty Thyself, and without passion didst stoop down even unto sufferings: grant peace unto me who have fallen, O Lover of mankind.[^7106]

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Penitential Canon to our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the Holy Martyrs. By Lord Joseph. Tone 6. Ode 1. Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Хра́мъ бы́лъ є҆сѝ бж҃твенныѧ Тро́йцы, и҆ въ хра́мѣ твое́мъ ст҃о́мъ се́мъ собра́нніи, вѣ́рою те́плою мо́лимъ тѧ̀ Предте́че: и҆зба́ви на́съ ѿ и҆скꙋше́ній и҆ скорбе́й, всехва́льне.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion 1:* Thou wast a temple of the Holy Trinity, and we who are gathered in this holy temple of thine, with fervent faith entreat thee, O Forerunner: Deliver us from temptations and afflictions, O all-praised one.[^7107]

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Penitential Canon to our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the Holy Martyrs. By Lord Joseph. Tone 6. Ode 1. Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Оу҆страни́выйсѧ всѧ́кїа добродѣ́тели оу҆́мъ мо́й, тебѐ стра́ннымъ ходи́вша пꙋте́мъ въ житіѝ Блаже́нне, ны́нѣ молю̀: всѧ́ческихъ Бг҃ꙋ мѧ присво́й, лꙋ́чша творѧ́ мѧ и҆зѧ́щными припада́ньми.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion 2:* With my mind estranged from every virtue, I pray thee now, O Blessed One, who didst walk a strange path in life: Unite me unto the God of all, making me better through excellent entreaties.[^7108]

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Penitential Canon to our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the Holy Martyrs. By Lord Joseph. Tone 6. Ode 1. Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Погрꙋзи́вый въ І҆орда́нскихъ стрꙋѧ́хъ, бе́зднꙋ милосе́рдіа Проро́че, то́ки страсте́й мои́хъ моли́твами твои́ми и҆зсꙋшѝ ны́нѣ, и҆сто́чники мнѣ̀ сле́зъ подава́ѧ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion 3:* O Prophet who didst immerse in the streams of the Jordan the abyss of tender mercy, dry up now by thy prayers the torrents of my passions, granting me fountains of tears.[^7109]

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Penitential Canon to our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the Holy Martyrs. By Lord Joseph. Tone 6. Ode 1. Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Бг҃оро́диченъ. Преꙋкра́шенна бж҃твенными лꙋча́ми, кра́снаго добро́тою родила̀ є҆сѝ Дѣ́во: тогѡ̀ оу҆́бѡ при́снѡ молѝ, спастѝ на́съ ѿ тлѝ, и҆́же вѣ́рою и҆ любо́вію тѧ̀ сла́вѧщїа.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Theotokion:* Adorned with divine rays, O Virgin, thou gavest birth unto Him Who is fair in beauty; Him do thou ever entreat, to save from corruption us who in faith and love glorify thee.[^7110]

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Penitential Canon to our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the Holy Martyrs. By Lord Joseph. Tone 6. Ode 1. Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Пѣ́снь ѕ҃. І҆рмо́съ. Возопи́хъ всѣ́мъ се́рдцемъ мои́мъ къ ще́дромꙋ Бг҃ꙋ, и҆ оу҆слы́ша мѧ ѿ а҆́да преиспо́днягѡ и҆ возведѐ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Tone 6. Ode 6. Heirmos:* I cried with my whole heart unto the merciful God, and He heard me from the lowest hades, and brought up my life from corruption.[^7111]

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Penitential Canon to our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the Holy Martyrs. By Lord Joseph. Tone 6. Ode 1. Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Не покажѝ менѐ бѣсѡ́мъ ѡ҆бра́дованіе въ де́нь стра́шный, Хрⷭ҇тѐ І҆и҃се: да не оу҆слы́шꙋ тогда̀ гла́са ѿсыла́ющагѡ въ ѻ҆́гнь гее́нскій.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion 1:* Show me not forth as a rejoicing for demons in the dread day, O Christ Jesus, that I may not hear then the voice that sends me away into the fire of Gehenna.[^7112]

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Penitential Canon to our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the Holy Martyrs. By Lord Joseph. Tone 6. Ode 1. Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Погрꙋзи́ мѧ въ глꙋбинѣ̀ прегрѣше́ній, и҆́же пра́ведныхъ вра́гъ; къ щедро́тъ твои́хъ притѣка́ю пꙋчи́нѣ, І҆и҃се, къ приста́нищꙋ жи́зни ны́нѣ напра́ви мѧ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion 2:* The enemy of the righteous has drowned me in the depth of transgressions; I flee unto the deep of Thy compassions, O Jesus; guide me now unto the haven of life.[^7113]

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Penitential Canon to our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the Holy Martyrs. By Lord Joseph. Tone 6. Ode 1. Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Мꙋ́чениченъ. Болѣ́зней мно́гихъ ра́ломъ, ѡ҆бно́вльше дꙋше́внꙋю браздꙋ̀ Премꙋ́дріи, бж҃твеннымъ сѣ́менемъ вѣ́ры, многопло́дный мꙋче́ніа кла́съ ꙗ҆́вѣ плодоноси́сте.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Martyrikon:* Having renewed the furrow of the soul with the plow of many sufferings, O Most Wise Ones, by the divine seed of faith ye manifestly bare fruit in the abundant ear of martyrdom.[^7114]

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Penitential Canon to our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the Holy Martyrs. By Lord Joseph. Tone 6. Ode 1. Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Мꙋ́чениченъ. Ꙗ҆́звами оу҆ѧзви́сте оу҆ѧзви́вшаго ва́съ, благочести́віи ѻ҆рꙋ́жници: тѣ́мже преста́вльшесѧ къ жи́зни, стра́сти ны́нѣ человѣ́ческїа и҆сцѣлѧ́ете.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Martyrikon:* By wounds ye wounded him that wounded you, O pious warriors; therefore, having passed over unto life, ye now heal human passions.[^7115]

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Penitential Canon to our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the Holy Martyrs. By Lord Joseph. Tone 6. Ode 1. Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Бг҃оро́диченъ. Хра́мъ Бг҃ꙋ ꙗ҆ви́ласѧ є҆сѝ Всенепоро́чнаѧ, въ ѻ҆́нже все́лсѧ свѧще́ннѣ, человѣ́ческое сꙋщество̀ ѡ҆божѝ, сотвори́вый вѣ́рныхъ хра́мы себѣ̀.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Theotokion:* Thou wast shown forth as a temple unto God, O All-Immaculate One, in which He holy dwelt, deifying human nature, having made the faithful temples unto Himself.[^7116]

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Penitential Canon to our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the Holy Martyrs. By Lord Joseph. Tone 6. Ode 1. Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Бе́здна послѣ́днаѧ грѣхѡ́въ ѡ҆бы́де мѧ, и҆ волне́ніа не ктомꙋ̀ терпѧ̀, ꙗ҆́кѡ І҆ѡ́на Влады́цѣ вопію̀ тебѣ̀: ѿ тлѝ мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Canon to the Forerunner. Heirmos:* The lowest abyss of sins has compassed me about, and enduring no longer its surging, as Jonah unto the Master I cry unto Thee Lead me up from corruption.[^7117]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ѡ҆тра́сль Проро́че ѿ ко́рене прозѧ́блъ є҆сѝ, и҆ сердца̀ непло́днаѧ всѧ́кагѡ благоразꙋ́міа, благопло́дна въ похвалꙋ̀ Бг҃ꙋ показа́лъ є҆сѝ.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Сокрꙋшѝ вско́рѣ лꙋка́ваго нога́ми на́шими, и҆ и҆спра́ви стѡпы̀ на̑ша мы́сленныѧ на пꙋ́ть ми́ра, предста́тельствы твои́ми, Предте́че.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Penitential Canon to our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the Holy Martyrs. By Lord Joseph. Tone 6. Ode 1. Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Бг҃оро́диченъ. Пѣ́снь тебѣ̀ Дѣ́во благодаре́ніа прино́симъ ны́нѣ; тобо́ю Чи́стаѧ спасе́ни бы́вше ѿ кла́твы дре́внїа, и҆ всѧ́ко благослове́ніе пло́димъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Theotokion:* A song of thanksgiving we offer unto thee now, O Virgin; through thee, O Pure One, having been saved from the ancient curse, we bear fruit in every blessing.[^7121]

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Penitential Canon to our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the Holy Martyrs. By Lord Joseph. Tone 6. Ode 1. Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Пѣ́снь з҃. І҆рмо́съ. Согрѣши́хомъ, беззако́нновахомъ, непра́вдовахомъ пред̾ тобо́ю, нижѐ соблюдо́хомъ, нижѐ сотвори́хомъ, ꙗ҆́коже заповѣ́далъ є҆сѝ на́мъ; но не преда́ждь на́съ до конца̀, ѻ҆тце́въ Бж҃е.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Tone 6. Ode 7. Heirmos:* We have sinned, we have transgressed, we have done unrighteously before Thee, neither kept nor done as Thou hast commanded us; but give us not up utterly, O God of the fathers.[^7122]

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Penitential Canon to our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the Holy Martyrs. By Lord Joseph. Tone 6. Ode 1. Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Взира́ю на ми́лость твою̀ безмѣ́рнꙋю, безмѣ́рнѡ согрѣши́вый; вѣ́мь твоѐ милосе́рдіе; вѣ́мь долготерпѣ́ніе и҆ неѕло́біе. Покаѧ́ніа мнѣ̀ да́рꙋй плоды̀, ще́дрый Хрⷭ҇тѐ, и҆ спаси́ мѧ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion 1:* I look upon Thy measureless mercy, who have immeasurably sinned; I know Thy tender compassion; I know Thy longsuffering and meekness. Grant me fruits of repentance, O compassionate Christ, and save me.[^7123]

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Penitential Canon to our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the Holy Martyrs. By Lord Joseph. Tone 6. Ode 1. Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Оу҆врачꙋ́й Ще́дре се́рдца моегѡ̀ неисцѣ̑льныѧ стра́сти; да́рꙋй ѡ҆сѣче́ніе долго́въ мои́хъ; тѧ́жкое бре́мѧ ѡ҆блегчѝ: да въ оу҆миле́ніи тѧ̀ сла́влю при́снѡ ѻ҆тце́въ Бг҃а.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion 2:* Heal, O Compassionate One, the incurable passions of my heart; grant the cutting off of my debts; lighten the heavy burden: that in compunction I may ever glorify Thee, the God of the fathers.[^7124]

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Penitential Canon to our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the Holy Martyrs. By Lord Joseph. Tone 6. Ode 1. Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Мꙋ́чениченъ. Ꙗ҆́звљеми, ссѣца́еми, и҆ снѣда́еми ѻ҆гне́мъ веще́ственнымъ, львѡ́мъ предае́ми на снѣ́дь, и҆ протѧза́еми на колесѣ́хъ, не ѿверго́шасѧ тебѐ жива́гѡ Бг҃а на́шегѡ, бж҃твенніи и҆ сщ҃е́нніи страда́лци.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Martyrikon:* Wounded, cut to pieces, consumed by material fire, given unto lions for food, and stretched upon wheels, they denied Thee not, our living God, the divine and sacred sufferers.[^7125]

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Penitential Canon to our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the Holy Martyrs. By Lord Joseph. Tone 6. Ode 1. Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Мꙋ́чениченъ. Раздѣлѧ́еми бы́сте ѿ тѣ́ла, но не раздѣле́ни ѿ Бг҃а ꙗ҆ви́стесѧ Мꙋ́ченици, совокꙋпле́ніа ра́ди бж҃твеннагѡ, себѐ соедини́вшагѡ на́мъ нетлѣ́ннѡ. Є҆го́же при́снѡ моли́те, и҆зба́вити сѧ на́мъ всѧ́кіа нꙋ́жды.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Martyrikon:* Ye were separated from the body, but were shown not separated from God, O Martyrs, for the sake of the divine union of Him Who united Himself incorruptibly unto us. Him do ye ever entreat, that we may be delivered from every necessity.[^7126]

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Penitential Canon to our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the Holy Martyrs. By Lord Joseph. Tone 6. Ode 1. Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Бг҃оро́диченъ. Прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ безъ сѣ́мене, є҆го́же родѝ Ѻ҆те́цъ нетлѣ́ннѡ; пребыла̀ є҆сѝ по рождествѣ̀ Дѣ́ва, ꙗ҆́кѡже и҆ пре́жде рождества̀. Тѣ́мже оу҆блажа́ема є҆сѝ, и҆ просла́влѧема Пречи́стаѧ непреста́ннѡ, ꙗ҆́кѡ Ма́ти сꙋ́щи Бж҃іа.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Theotokion:* Without seed didst thou sprout forth Him Whom the Father incorruptibly begat; thou remainedst a Virgin after childbearing, even as before childbearing. Therefore art thou called blessed, and unceasingly glorified, O All-Pure One, as being the Mother of God.[^7127]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ѻ҆́троци въ Вавѷлѡ́нѣ, пе́щнагѡ пла́мене не оу҆боѧ́шасѧ, но посредѣ̀ пла́- мене вве́ржени, ѡ҆роша́еми поѧ́хꙋ: благослове́нъ є҆сѝ Гдⷭ҇и Бж҃е ѻ҆те́цъ на́шихъ.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Penitential Canon to our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the Holy Martyrs. By Lord Joseph. Tone 6. Ode 1. Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Гла́съ сы́й Сло́ва, ны́нѣ гла́сы на́шѧ пріимѝ Крести́телю: и҆ страсте́й и҆ бѣ́дъ, и҆ мно́гихъ ѡ҆бстоѧ́ній, и҆ вѣ́чнагѡ мꙋче́ніа и҆зба́ви лю́ди твоѧ̑.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion 1:* Being the voice of the Word, receive now our voices, O Baptist, and deliver thy people from passions, tribulations, many distresses, and eternal torment.[^7129]

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Penitential Canon to our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the Holy Martyrs. By Lord Joseph. Tone 6. Ode 1. Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Рꙋко́ю показꙋ́еши Проро́че, А҆́гнца Бж҃іа, мі́ра взе́млющаго грѣхѝ. Є҆го́же при́снѡ молѝ, ѿѧ́ти моѧ̑ согрѣше́ніа лю̑таѧ, и҆ лѣ́ты оу҆держа̑ннаѧ, и҆ живота̀ сподо́бити мѧ̀.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion 2:* With thy hand thou pointest out, O Prophet, the Lamb of God Who takes away the sins of the world; Him do thou ever entreat, to take away my fierce transgressions held fast through the years, and to vouchsafe me life.[^7130]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Дꙋшѐ моѧ̀, потщи́сѧ и҆ возопі́й, ѡ҆мраче́ніе ѡ҆ста́вльши безслове́сныхъ дѣѧ́ній: оу҆ще́дри мѧ І҆и҃се мольба́ми Крести́телѧ, и҆ и҆схити́ мѧ тимѣ́ніа дѣ́лъ мои́хъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion 3:* O my soul, make haste and cry aloud, forsaking the darkening of irrational deeds: Have compassion upon me, O Jesus, by the supplications of the Baptist, and snatch me from the mire of my deeds.[^7131]

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Penitential Canon to our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the Holy Martyrs. By Lord Joseph. Tone 6. Ode 1. Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Бг҃оро́диченъ. Є҆мꙋ́же предстоѧ́тъ съ тре́петомъ небе́сніи чи́ни, тогѡ̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ Чи́стаѧ, соедини́вшагосѧ человѣ́кѡмъ за бла́гость. Є҆го́же прилѣ́жнѡ молѝ, оу҆ще́дрити рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Theotokion:* Him before Whom the heavenly ranks stand with trembling, hast thou brought forth, O Pure One, Who for goodness' sake united Himself unto men; Him do thou fervently entreat, to have compassion upon thy servants.[^7132]

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Penitential Canon to our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the Holy Martyrs. By Lord Joseph. Tone 6. Ode 1. Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Пѣ́снь и҃. І҆рмо́съ. Є҆го́же вѡ́инства небе́снаѧ сла́вѧтъ, и҆ трепе́щꙋтъ Херꙋві́ми и҆ Серафі́ми, всѧ́кое дыха́ніе и҆ тва́рь по́йте, благослови́те и҆ превозноси́те во всѧ̑ вѣ́ки.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Tone 6. Ode 8. Heirmos:* Him Whom the heavenly hosts glorify, and before Whom the Cherubim and Seraphim tremble: let every breath and creation sing, bless, and supremely exalt unto all ages.[^7133]

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Penitential Canon to our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the Holy Martyrs. By Lord Joseph. Tone 6. Ode 1. Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Взира́ю на вели́кꙋю ми́лость щедро́тъ твои́хъ Хрⷭ҇тѐ, ꙗ҆́кѡже Даві́дъ, согрѣши́въ па́че ѻ҆́нагѡ, и҆ зовꙋ̀ съ ѻ҆́нѣмъ: є҆ди́не Ми́лостиве, поми́лꙋй мѧ вско́рѣ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion 1:* I look upon the great mercy of Thy compassions, O Christ, having sinned more than David; and I cry with him: O only Merciful One, have mercy upon me swiftly.[^7134]

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Penitential Canon to our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the Holy Martyrs. By Lord Joseph. Tone 6. Ode 1. Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Коне́цъ бла́гъ бы́ти мнѣ̀, молю́сѧ, положи́ти же лꙋка́вымъ дѣѧ́ніемъ когда̀ коне́цъ не оу҆се́рдствꙋю, помраче́ніемъ ѡ҆жесточе́нное и҆мѣ́ѧ се́рдце; оу҆ще́дри мѧ Бж҃ій Сло́ве.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion 2:* I pray that I may have a good end, yet I strive not ever to put an end to wicked deeds, having a heart hardened by darkening; have compassion upon me, O Word of God.[^7135]

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Penitential Canon to our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the Holy Martyrs. By Lord Joseph. Tone 6. Ode 1. Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ꙗ҆́кѡ и҆збра̑нныѧ и҆ непоро́чныѧ же́ртвы, поже́ршемꙋсѧ на́съ ра́ди, є҆диноро́дномꙋ Сло́вꙋ, во́лею принесо́стесѧ, же́ртвы всѧ̑ оу҆пражнѧ́юще де́мѡнскіѧ, страстоте́рпцы.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Martyrikon:* As chosen and blameless sacrifices, ye willingly offered yourselves unto the Only-begotten Word Who was sacrificed for our sake, bringing to nought all demonic sacrifices, O passion-bearers.[^7136]

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Penitential Canon to our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the Holy Martyrs. By Lord Joseph. Tone 6. Ode 1. Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Мꙋ́чениченъ. Жи́ламъ сѣче́ніа, зꙋбѡ́въ и҆скорене́ніа, ѿѧ́тіе же рꙋ́къ, раздрабле́ніе оу҆дѡ́въ, и҆ всѧ́кое томле́ніе и҆но́е претерпѣ́сте до́блественнѣ, Мꙋ́ченници, пою́ще Хрⷭ҇та̀ є҆ди́наго подвигополо́жника.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Martyrikon:* The severing of sinews, the pulling out of teeth, the cutting off of hands, the shattering of limbs, and every other torment did ye valiantly endure, O Martyrs, singing unto Christ the only Arbiter of the contest.[^7137]

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Penitential Canon to our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the Holy Martyrs. By Lord Joseph. Tone 6. Ode 1. Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Бг҃оро́диченъ. Но́ва на́мъ Младе́нца родила̀ є҆сѝ, ве́тхаго де́ньми, нѡ́выѧ на землѝ стезѝ показꙋ́ющаго, и҆ ѡ҆бветша́вшее є҆стество̀ ѡ҆бновлѧ́ющаго, безневѣ́стнаѧ Благослове́ннаѧ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Theotokion:* A new Babe hast thou brought forth for us, Him Who is Ancient of Days, Who shows new paths upon earth and renews nature that had grown old, O unwedded, blessed Maiden.[^7138]

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Penitential Canon to our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the Holy Martyrs. By Lord Joseph. Tone 6. Ode 1. Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: За зако́ны ѻ҆те́чєскїа блаже́нніи въ Вавѷлѡ́нѣ ю҆́нѡши бѣ́дствꙋюще, царю́ющагѡ ѡ҆плева́ша повелѣ́нїе безꙋ́мное; и҆ совокꙋплени и҆́мже не совари́шасѧ ѻ҆гне́мъ, Держа́вствꙋющемꙋ досто́йнꙋю воспѣва́хꙋ пѣ́снь: Гдⷭ҇а по́йте дѣла̀, и҆ превозноси́те во всѧ̑ вѣ́ки.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Canon to the Forerunner. Heirmos:* In Babylon the blessed youths, imperiled for the ancestral laws spat upon the senseless decree of him that reigned; and joined together, not consumed by the fire, they sang a worthy song unto the Sovereign Ruler: Sing, ye works, unto the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages.[^7139]

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Penitential Canon to our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the Holy Martyrs. By Lord Joseph. Tone 6. Ode 1. Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: На́дъ Сло́во креща́емо, въ ви́дѣ голꙋби́нѣ низходѧ́ща ви́дѣлъ є҆сѝ Дх҃а ст҃а́го, и҆ гла́съ Ѻ҆́тчь слы́шати сподо́билсѧ є҆сѝ Блаже́нне: се́й є҆́сть Сы́нъ мо́й сопресто́льный, є҆го́же пое́тъ всѧ̀ тва́рь: Гдⷭ҇а по́йте дѣла̀, и҆ превозноси́те во всѧ̑ вѣ́ки.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion 1:* Above the Word being baptized, thou didst behold the Holy Spirit descending in the likeness of a dove, and wast vouchsafed to hear the Father's voice, O Blessed One: "This is My Son Who shares My throne," Whom all creation sings: Sing, ye works, unto the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages.[^7140]

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Penitential Canon to our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the Holy Martyrs. By Lord Joseph. Tone 6. Ode 1. Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ѻ҆гне́мъ Проро́че твои́хъ моли́твъ, хвра́стныѧ стра́сти смы́сла моегѡ̀ попали́въ, и҆ оу҆гаше́ный се́рдца моегѡ̀ свѣ́щникъ возжжѝ па́ки: ꙗ҆́ко да ꙗ҆́снѡ смотрѧ́ѧ, воспѣва́ю созда́вшаго свѣ́тъ повелѣ́ній: Гдⷭ҇а по́йте дѣла̀, и҆ превозноси́те во всѧ̑ вѣ́ки.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion 2:* By the fire of thy prayers, O Prophet, consume the brushwood passions of my mind, and rekindle the extinguished lamp of my heart, that looking clearly I may sing unto Him Who created the light of commandments: Sing, ye works, unto the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages.[^7141]

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Penitential Canon to our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the Holy Martyrs. By Lord Joseph. Tone 6. Ode 1. Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Скры́вый ра́бъ тала́нтъ, є҆го́же въ дѣ́ланіе ѿ тебѐ пріѧ́хъ, а҆́зъ є҆́смь ѡ҆каѧ́нный; и҆ что̀ сотворю̀, є҆гда̀ на сꙋ́дъ пріи́деши, коегѡ́ждо дѣ́ло и҆стѧзꙋ́ѧ? Но пощади́ мѧ мольба́ми Предте́чи твоегѡ̀, и҆ не въ ѻ҆́гнь послѝ вопію́ща: Гдⷭ҇а воспѣва́йте дѣла̀, и҆ превозноси́те є҆го̀ въ вѣ́ки.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion 3:* I am that wretched servant who hid the talent which I received from Thee for trading; and what shall I do when Thou comest to judgment, demanding an account of everyone's work? But spare me by the supplications of Thy Forerunner, and send me not into the fire who cry aloud: Sing, ye works, unto the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto the ages.[^7142]

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Penitential Canon to our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the Holy Martyrs. By Lord Joseph. Tone 6. Ode 1. Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Бг҃оро́диченъ. Соблюдѝ мо́й смы́слъ въ смире́ніи Ѻ҆трокови́це бг҃облагода́тнаѧ, ꙗ҆́же рождество́мъ твои́мъ сокрꙋши́вшаѧ возноше́ніе де́мѡнское; и҆ воздви́гни мѧ ѿ гно́ища страсте́й, и҆ а҆́лчꙋща мѧ насы́ти благода́ти твоеѧ̀, пою́ща: Гдⷭ҇а по́йте дѣла̀, и҆ превозноси́те въ всѧ̑ вѣ́ки.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Theotokion:* Preserve my mind in humility, O Maiden full of God's grace, who by thy childbearing didst crush demonic arrogance; and raise me up from the dunghill of passions, and satisfy me who hunger for thy grace, singing: Sing, ye works, unto the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages.[^7143]

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Penitential Canon to our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the Holy Martyrs. By Lord Joseph. Tone 6. Ode 1. Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Пѣ́снь ѳ҃. І҆рмо́съ. Безсѣ́меннагѡ зача́тіа рождество̀ несказа́нно, Ма́тере безмꙋ́жныѧ нетлѣ́ненъ пло́дъ; Бж҃іе бо рожде́ніе ѡ҆бновлѧ́етъ є҆стества̀. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѝ ро́ди ꙗ҆́кѡ бг҃оневѣ́стнꙋю Ма́терь, правосла́внѡ велича́емъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Tone 6. Ode 9. Heirmos:* The birth from a seedless conception is ineffable, the fruit of an unwedded Mother is incorrupt; for the birth of God renews nature. Therefore all generations rightly magnify thee as the Mother unwedded of God.[^7144]

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Penitential Canon to our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the Holy Martyrs. By Lord Joseph. Tone 6. Ode 1. Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: І҆и҃се человѣколю́бче, є҆ди́не не́мощь на́шꙋ вѣ́дый: въ сію̀ бо ѡ҆бле́клсѧ є҆сѝ милосе́рдіа ра́ди, хотѧ̀ сію̀ ѡ҆чи́стити. Тѣ́мже скве́рны лꙋка̑выѧ, и҆ гное́ніа ѕѡ́лъ мои́хъ ѡ҆чи́сти, и҆ спаси́ мѧ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion 1:* O Jesus Lover of mankind, Who alone knowest our weakness, for Thou didst clothe Thyself with it for mercy's sake, desiring to cleanse it: therefore cleanse the wicked defilements and suppurations of my evils, and save me.[^7145]

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Penitential Canon to our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the Holy Martyrs. By Lord Joseph. Tone 6. Ode 1. Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ꙗ҆́кѡ блꙋдни́ца сле́зы приношꙋ̀ тебѣ̀, Человѣколю́бче; ꙗ҆́кѡ мыта́рь стенѧ̀ взыва́ю тебѣ̀: ѡ҆чи́сти, и҆ спаси́ мѧ! Ꙗ҆́кѡже ханане́а вопію̀: поми́лꙋй мѧ! ꙗ҆́кѡже Петра̀ пока́ѧвшасѧ, проще́ніа сподо́би.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion 2:* Like the harlot I offer tears unto Thee, O Lover of mankind; like the publican groaning I call unto Thee: Cleanse and save me! Like the Canaanite woman I cry: Have mercy on me! Like Peter who repented, vouchsafe me forgiveness.[^7146]

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Penitential Canon to our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the Holy Martyrs. By Lord Joseph. Tone 6. Ode 1. Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Мꙋ́чениченъ. Пло́тію спле́тшесѧ безпло́тномꙋ міроде́ржцꙋ, по́двигами страда́ній тогѡ̀ низложи́сте, и҆ побѣ́ды вѣнцы̀ пріѧ́сте досто́йнѡ. Тѣ́мже моли́тесѧ прилѣ́жнѡ ѡ҆ всѣ́хъ, вѣ́рою восхваля́ющихъ ва́съ, Ст҃і́и.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Martyrikon:* Grappling in the flesh with the bodiless ruler of this world, by the struggles of your sufferings ye cast him down, and worthily received the crowns of victory; therefore pray fervently for all who in faith praise you, O Saints.[^7147]

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Penitential Canon to our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the Holy Martyrs. By Lord Joseph. Tone 6. Ode 1. Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Бг҃оро́диченъ. Гла́съ тебѣ̀ прино́симъ А҆рха́нгеловъ, Всечи́стаѧ, Благослове́ннаѧ: ра́дꙋйсѧ, вмѣсти́вшаѧ Бг҃а невмѣсти́маго; ра́дꙋйсѧ, кла́твы разрѣше́ніе, и҆ благослове́ніа введе́ніе; ра́дꙋйсѧ, є҆ди́на ра́йскꙋю две́рь ѿве́рзшаѧ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Theotokion:* We offer the Archangel's voice unto thee, O All-Pure, Blessed One: Rejoice, thou that didst contain the uncontainable God; rejoice, loosening of the curse, and bringing in of blessing; rejoice, who alone didst open the door of Paradise.[^7149]

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Penitential Canon to our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the Holy Martyrs. By Lord Joseph. Tone 6. Ode 1. Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Стра́нствіа Влады́чна, и҆ безсме́ртныѧ трапе́зы на го́рнѣмъ мѣ́стѣ, высо́кими оу҆мы̀, вѣ́рніи пріиди́те наслади́мсѧ возше́дшагѡ сло́ва, ѿ Сло́ва наꙋчи́вшесѧ, є҆го́же велича́емъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Canon to the Forerunner. Heirmos:* Come, ye faithful, with lofty minds let us enjoy the Master's hospitality and the immortal table in the upper place, having learned the word of Him Who ascended from the Word, Whom we magnify.[^7150]

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Penitential Canon to our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the Holy Martyrs. By Lord Joseph. Tone 6. Ode 1. Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Оу҆врачꙋ́й мо́й оу҆́мъ, сластолю́біемъ жите́йскимъ лю́тѣ оу҆ѧ́звленый, и҆ оу҆толѝ ѕѣ́лнѣ возмꙋща́ющꙋю мѧ бꙋ́рю, и҆ покажѝ мнѣ̀ покаѧ́ніа пꙋтѝ пра̑выѧ, Гдⷭ҇ень Предте́че.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion 1:* Heal my mind grievously wounded by the love of worldly pleasures, and calm the storm that exceedingly troubles me, and show me the upright paths of repentance, O Forerunner of the Lord.[^7151]

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Penitential Canon to our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the Holy Martyrs. By Lord Joseph. Tone 6. Ode 1. Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ви́дѣнъ бы́лъ є҆сѝ посредѣ̀ стоѧ̀ ве́тхагѡ же и҆ но́вагѡ: ѻ҆́вомꙋ оу҆́бѡ Проро́че преста́ти творѧ̀, ѻ҆́вагѡ же свѣ́тъ ꙗ҆влѧ́ѧ; и҆́мже ходи́ти спѣ́шнѡ наста́ви на́съ, со́вѣстію бж҃е́ственною, ꙗ҆́ко да тмы̀ и҆зба́вимсѧ вѣчнꙋющїа.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion 2:* Thou wast seen standing in the midst of the Old and New: causing the one, O Prophet, to cease, and revealing the light of the other; in which guide us to walk diligently, with a divine conscience, that we may be delivered from eternal darkness.[^7152]

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Penitential Canon to our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the Holy Martyrs. By Lord Joseph. Tone 6. Ode 1. Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Сочета́лсѧ є҆сѝ съ вѡ́инствы небе́сными Богомꙋ́дре: съ ни́миже Хрⷭ҇та̀ молѝ, сꙋ́щихъ на землѝ на́съ спастѝ, почита́ющихъ тѧ въ честнѣ́мъ твое́мъ се́мъ хра́мѣ, Крести́телю І҆ѡа́нне, Гдⷭ҇ень Предте́че.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion 3:* Thou hast been joined unto the heavenly hosts, O Divinely Wise One; with them entreat Christ to save us who are upon earth, who honor thee in this thine honorable temple, O Baptist John, Forerunner of the Lord.[^7153]

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Penitential Canon to our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the Holy Martyrs. By Lord Joseph. Tone 6. Ode 1. Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Де́нь и҆спо́лнь ꙗ҆́рости, де́нь тмы̀ є҆́сть, дѣла̀ и҆мꙋ́щимъ те́мнаѧ, сꙋ́дъ стра́шный. Крести́телю Хрⷭ҇то́въ и҆ Предте́че, моли́твами твои́ми тогда̀ и҆зба́ви ѡ҆сꙋжде́ніа всѧ́кагѡ, тебѐ почита́ющихъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion 4:* A day full of wrath, a day of darkness is the dread judgment unto them that have dark deeds; O Baptist and Forerunner of Christ, by thy prayers deliver from all condemnation then those who honor thee.[^7154]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Бг҃оро́диченъ. Ꙗ҆ви́ласѧ є҆сѝ Херꙋві̑мъ ст҃ѣ́йши Дѣ́во, ꙗ҆́кѡ Бг҃а ро́ждшаѧ прест҃а́го. Всѣ́хъ на́съ ѡ҆свѧтѝ, въ гла́сѣхъ ст҃ы́хъ вѣ́рою, въ нощѝ и҆ въ днѝ тебѐ ѡ҆свѧща́ющихъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Theotokion:* Thou wast shown forth holier than the Cherubim, O Virgin, as having given birth unto the all-holy God. Sanctify all of us who in holy voices with faith sanctify thee by night and by day.[^7155]

items.section: At the Aposticha, Penitential Stichera, Tone 6
items.slavonic_diplomatic: На́га мѧ ѡ҆брѣ́тъ добродѣ́телей вра́гъ, стрѣло́ю грѣхо́вною оу҆ѧзвѝ; но ты̀ ꙗ҆́кѡ вра́чь дꙋ́шъ и҆ тѣле́съ, ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ и҆сцѣлѝ, и҆ поми́лꙋй мѧ̀.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Sticheron 1:* Having found me stripped of virtues, the enemy wounded me with the arrow of sin; but do Thou, as Physician of souls and bodies, heal the wounds of my soul, and have mercy upon me.[^7157]

items.section: At the Aposticha, Penitential Stichera, Tone 6
items.preceding_stichos: Verse: We were filled in the morning with Thy mercy, O Lord, and we rejoiced and were glad: ... And look upon Thy servants, and upon Thy works, and guide their sons.*[^7158]
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Стíхъ: Испо́лнихомсѧ зау́тра ми́лости твоеѧ̀ Гдⷭ҇и, и҆ возра́довахомсѧ и҆ возвесели́хомсѧ: ... И҆ при́зри на рабы̑ твоѧ̑, и҆ на дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, и҆ наста́ви сы́ны и҆́хъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Sticheron 2:* Heal the sores of my heart, grown great from many transgressions, O Savior, as Physician of souls and bodies, granting forgiveness of transgressions ever unto those who ask; grant me tears of repentance, giving me release from debts, O Lord, and have mercy on me.[^7159]

items.section: At the Aposticha, Penitential Stichera, Tone 6
items.preceding_stichos: Verse: And let the brightness of the Lord our God be upon us, and direct Thou the works of our hands upon us; yea, the work of our hands direct Thou.*[^7160]
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Гдⷭ҇и, а҆́ще не бы́хомъ Ст҃ы̑ѧ твоѧ̑ и҆мѣ́ли моли́твенники, и҆ благосты́ню твою̀ ми́лꙋющꙋю на́съ, ка́кѡ смѣ́ли бы́хомъ Сп҃се пѣ́ти тѧ̀, є҆го́же славосло́вѧтъ непреста́ннѡ А҆́гг҃ли? Се́рдцевѣ́дче, пощадѝ дꙋ́ши на́ша.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Martyrikon:* O Lord, if we had not Thy Saints as intercessors, and Thy goodness having mercy upon us, how should we dare, O Savior, to hymn Thee Whom the Angels ceaselessly glorify? O Knower of hearts, spare our souls.[^7161]

items.section: At the Aposticha, Penitential Stichera, Tone 6
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Сла́ва: и҆ ны́нѣ: Бг҃оро́диченъ. Вели́кихъ дарова́ній, чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во Бг҃ома́ти ты̀ сподо́биласѧ є҆сѝ: ꙗ҆́кѡ родила̀ є҆сѝ пло́тію є҆ди́наго ѿ Трⷪ҇ци, Хрⷭ҇та̀ жизнода́вца, въ спасе́ніе дꙋ́шъ на́шихъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Glory... Both now... Theotokion:* Of great gifts hast thou been accounted worthy, O pure Virgin Mother of God: for in the flesh thou didst bring forth One of the Trinity, Christ the Giver of life, unto the salvation of our souls.[^7162]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Распе́ншꙋсѧ тебѣ̀ долготерпѣли́ве Гдⷭ҇и,* поколеба́лъ є҆сѝ зе́млю всю̀,* вѣ́рныхъ же ᲂу҆тверди́въ сердца̀.* Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ воспѣва́емъ,* и҆ любо́вїю покланѧ́емсѧ непостижи́мѣй си́лѣ твое́й.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Sticheron 1:* When Thou wast crucified, O long-suffering Lord, Thou didst shake the whole earth, but didst establish the hearts of the faithful; therefore we sing Thy praise, and with love worship Thine unsearchable power.[^7171]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Въ лани́тꙋ заꙋше́нъ бы́лъ є҆сѝ Сп҃се,* и҆ ѡ҆плева́нъ,* ꙗ҆дови́тагѡ заꙋши́лъ є҆сѝ врага̀ ѕло́бꙋ,* ѿе́млѧ паде́ніе є҆́же пода́ть А҆да́мъ,* ᲂу҆кра́денъ бы́въ видѣ́нїа ра́ди.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Sticheron 2:* Thou wast struck upon the cheek, O Savior, and spat upon; Thou didst strike down the malice of the venomous foe, taking away the fall which Adam brought about, having been stolen away because of seeing.[^7172]

items.section: On "Lord, I have cried," Stichera of the Cross, Tone 6
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Предстоѧ́щи ᲂу҆̀ креста̀ и҆ногда̀, въ вре́мѧ распѧ́тїѧ Дѣ́ва, съ дѣ́вственникомъ ᲂу҆ченико́мъ, и҆ пла́чꙋщи вопїѧ́ше: ᲂу҆вы̀ мнѣ̀, ка́кѡ стра́ждеши Хрⷭ҇тѐ, всѣ́хъ сы́й безстра́стїе?
items.english_cohort_translation: *Sticheron 4:* Standing once by the Cross at the time of the Crucifixion, the Virgin, with the virgin disciple, weeping, cried aloud: Woe is me! How dost Thou suffer, O Christ, Who art the dispassion of all?[^7175]

internal_coordinates.podoben_label_raw: Having risen on the third day

items.section: On "Lord, I have cried," Stichera of the Cross, Tone 6
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Зача́тїе твоѐ безсѣ́менное, и҆ рождество̀ пречи́стое, помышлѧ́ющи ᲂу҆дивла́юсѧ ѕѣлѡ̀: ка́кѡ си́це ꙗ҆́кѡ ѕлодѣ́й, благоволи́лъ є҆сѝ ᲂу҆мре́ти Сп҃се? Пречи́стаѧ взыва́ше.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Sticheron 5:* Meditating upon Thy seedless conception and all-pure birthgiving, I marvel greatly: how hast Thou thus consented to die like an evildoer, O Savior? cried the All-Pure.[^7176]

items.section: On "Lord, I have cried," Stichera of the Cross, Tone 6
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Распина́юсѧ ᲂу҆́бѡ на дре́вѣ и҆ пригвожда́юсѧ ꙗ҆́кѡ человѣ́къ, и҆ въ гро́бѣ полага́юсѧ ꙗ҆́кѡ ме́ртвъ, Ма́ти чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во! ꙗ҆́кѡ Бг҃ъ же въ сла́вѣ па́ки воскреснꙋ̀ тридне́венъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Sticheron 6:* I am indeed crucified upon the Tree and nailed as man, and I am laid in the tomb as dead, O pure Virgin Mother! Yet as God in glory I shall rise again on the third day.[^7177]

items.section: On "Lord, I have cried," Stichera of the Cross, Tone 6
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Сла́ва: и҆ ны́нѣ: Крестобг҃оро́диченъ. Лю́ди беззако́ннѣйшїа, безъ пра́вды пригвожда́ющїа тѧ̀ на дре́вѣ, Дѣ́ва и҆ чи́стаѧ Ма́ти твоѧ̀ зрѧ́щи, ꙗ҆́коже Сѷмеѡ́нъ проречѐ, ᲂу҆тро́бою Сп҃се ᲂу҆ѧзвла́шесѧ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Glory... Both now... Stavrotheotokion:* Beholding the most lawless people unjustly nailing Thee upon the Tree, O Savior, the Virgin and Thy pure Mother was wounded in her inward parts, even as Simeon foretold.[^7178]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Кре́стъ тво́й Гдⷭ҇и, жи́знь и҆ застꙋпле́нїе лю́демъ твои̑мъ є҆́сть, и҆ на́нь надѣ́ющїисѧ, тебѐ распе́ншагосѧ пло́тїю Бг҃а на́шего пои́мъ: поми́лꙋй на́съ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Sticheron 1:* Thy Cross, O Lord, is life and defense unto Thy people; and hoping thereon, we hymn Thee our God Who wast crucified in the flesh: have mercy on us.[^7179]

items.preceding_stichos: Verse: Have mercy on us, O Lord, have mercy on us: .... For our soul is exceedingly filled with the reproach of the prosperous, and with the contempt of the proud.*[^7182]
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Страда́вшїи тебѐ ра́ди Хрⷭ҇тѐ, мнѡ́гїа мꙋ́ки претерпѣ́ша, и҆ соверше́нныѧ воспрїѧ́ша вѣнцы̀ на небесѣ́хъ: да мо́лѧтсѧ ѡ҆ дꙋша́хъ на́шихъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Martyrikon:* They that suffered for Thy sake, O Christ, endured many torments, and received perfect crowns in the heavens: let them pray for our souls.[^7183]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Сла́ва: и҆ ны́нѣ: Крестобг҃оро́диченъ. На дре́вѣ живо́тъ на́шъ, зрѧ́щи всенепоро́чнаѧ Бцⷣа ви́сѧщь, ма́терски рыда́ющи вопїѧ́ше: Сы́не мо́й, и҆ Бж҃е мо́й, спасѝ любо́вїю пою́щїѧ тѧ̀.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Glory... Both now... Stavrotheotokion:* Beholding our Life hanging upon the Tree, the all-blameless Theotokos cried out weeping with a mother's grief: O my Son and my God, save those who praise Thee with love.[^7184]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Вся́кѡ моегѡ̀ рыда́ю житїа̀ скве́рнагѡ, и҆ мно́жества безмѣ́рныхъ мои́хъ ѕѡ́лъ; что́ же и҆сповѣ́мь тебѣ̀ Чи́стаѧ? недоꙋмѣ́ю и҆ ᲂу҆жаса́юсѧ; но помозѝ мнѣ̀, Влады́чице.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion 1:* I bewail every aspect of my defiled life, and the multitude of my measureless evils; what then shall I confess unto thee, O Pure One? I am at a loss and terrified; but help me, O Sovereign Lady.[^7188]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Сла́ва: Сме́ртный ᲂу҆́бѡ ча́съ, и҆ сꙋди́ще стра́шное, всегда̀ помышлѧ́ю Пречи́стаѧ, ѡ҆блича́емъ же все ѕлы́мъ прельща́юсѧ лю́тѣ; но помозѝ мнѣ̀.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Glory...* The hour of death and the dread tribunal do I ever ponder, O All-Pure, yet being convicted I am all-grievously deceived by evil; but help me.[^7190]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: И҆ ны́нѣ: Благи́хъ тли́тель смотрѧ́ѧ мѧ̀ ны́нѣ на́га бж҃твенныхъ добродѣ́телей, и҆ дале́че ѿстꙋ́пльша и҆ ѿчꙋжде́на ѿ Бг҃а, поглоти́ти мѧ̀ ᲂу҆стремлѧ́етсѧ; Влады́чице предварѝ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Both now...* The corrupter of good things, beholding me now stripped of divine virtues, and having fallen away far and become alienated from God, strives to swallow me up; O Sovereign Lady, go before and anticipate him.[^7191]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: А҆́гг҃лстїи чи́нове, и҆ вѡ́инства небе́сныхъ си́лъ, твоегѡ̀ Сы́на ᲂу҆жаса́ютсѧ держа́вы, Чи́стаѧ: ны́нѣ же а҆́зъ ѿча́ѧвсѧ, безстра́шїемъ ѡ҆держи́мъ є҆́смь.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion 1:* The angelic ranks and hosts of the heavenly powers are terrified at the dominion of thy Son, O Pure One; but now having despaired, I am possessed by fearlessness.[^7198]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Оу҆диви́сѧ всѧ̀ землѧ̀ и҆ ᲂу҆жасе́сѧ, зрѧ́щи лю̑таѧ и҆ ѕла̑ѧ творѧ́ща мѧ̀, и҆ безмѣ̑стнаѧ: и҆ твоегѡ̀ Сы́на мно́гомꙋ милосе́рдїю чꙋди́тсѧ.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Сла́ва: Це́рковь ѡ҆скверни́хъ ѕлѣ̀ тѣле́снꙋю, и҆ це́рковь Гдⷭ҇ню, въ ню́же человѣ́ци трепе́щꙋще вхо́дѧтъ: а҆́зъ же блꙋ́дный безсты́днѡ вхождꙋ̀; ᲂу҆вы̀ мнѣ̀!
items.english_cohort_translation: *Glory...* The bodily church have I evilly defiled, and the church of the Lord, into which men enter trembling; but I, prodigal, enter shamelessly; woe is me![^7200]

items.verbatim_book_heading: TONE 6 :: On Tuesday at Compline, Tone 6
items.slavonic_diplomatic: И҆ ны́нѣ: Не ꙗ҆вѝ Влады́чице, не ꙗ҆вѝ стра́нна мѧ̀ ᲂу҆страни́вшасѧ кро́ва Сы́на твоегѡ̀, всѧ́кѡ недосто́йнаго; но ѡ҆мы́й менѐ ѿ скве́рны прегрѣше́ній мои́хъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Both now...* Show me not, O Sovereign Lady, show me not as a stranger, alienated from the protection of thy Son, being wholly unworthy; but wash me from the defilement of my transgressions.[^7201]

items.verbatim_book_heading: TONE 6 :: On Tuesday at Compline, Tone 6
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Пѣ́снь є҃. І҆рмо́съ. Бж҃їимъ свѣ́томъ твои́мъ Бла́же, ᲂу҆тренюющихъ тебѣ̀ дꙋ́ши любо́вїю ѡ҆зарѝ, молю́сѧ: тѧ̀ вѣ́дѣти Сло́ве Бж҃їй и҆́стиннаго Бг҃а, ѿ мра́ка грѣхо́внагѡ взыва́юща.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Ode 5. Heirmos:* With Thy divine light, O Good One, illumine, I pray, the souls of those who yearn early for Thee with love: that they may know Thee, O Word of God, the true God, calling them from the gloom of sin.[^7202]

items.verbatim_book_heading: TONE 6 :: On Tuesday at Compline, Tone 6
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Бж҃твеннымъ сїѧ́нїемъ твои́мъ Блага́ѧ, и҆сцѣлѝ дꙋше́вныѧ моѧ̑ стра̑сти, ꙗ҆̀же мнѣ̀ тли́тель всѣ́ѧ; и҆ и҆зба́ви мѧ̀ сегѡ̀ плѣне́нїа го́рькагѡ; смѣе́тсѧ бо, зрѧ̀ менѐ безъ застꙋпле́нїа.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion 1:* With thy divine radiance, O Good One, heal my soul's passions, which the corrupter sowed in me; and deliver me from this bitter captivity; for he laughs, seeing me without protection.[^7203]

items.verbatim_book_heading: TONE 6 :: On Tuesday at Compline, Tone 6
items.slavonic_diplomatic: А҆да́мъ престꙋпѝ ᲂу҆́бѡ за́повѣдь є҆ди́нꙋ Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во, и҆ въ и҆згна́нїе впадѐ; ка́кѡ же рыда́ю прегрѣше́ній мои́хъ бе́зднꙋ, а҆́зъ престꙋ́пный, и҆ ѿстꙋ́пникъ є҆гѡ̀?
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion 2:* Adam indeed transgressed one single commandment of thy Son, O Virgin, and fell into exile; how then shall I bewail the abyss of my transgressions, I who am a transgressor and an apostate from Him?[^7204]

items.verbatim_book_heading: TONE 6 :: On Tuesday at Compline, Tone 6
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Сла́ва: Оу҆бї́йца ᲂу҆́бѡ ꙗ҆ви́сѧ дре́вле, и҆ братоꙋбї́йца Ка́їнъ, Бг҃омъ про́клѧтъ бы́сть. Что́ же сотворю̀ а҆́зъ вседе́рзый? дꙋ́шꙋ ᲂу҆́бѡ ᲂу҆би́въ ны́нѣ, и҆ не стыждꙋ́сѧ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Glory...* A murderer indeed of old was Cain shown forth, and a fratricide, and he was cursed by God. What then shall I do, all-daring that I am? Having now slain my soul, and I am not ashamed.[^7205]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Пѣ́снь ѕ҃. І҆рмо́съ. Житéйское мо́ре воздвиза́емое зрѧ̀ напа́стей бꙋ́рею, къ ти́хомꙋ приста́нищꙋ твоемꙋ̀ прите́къ вопїю́ тебѣ̀: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Многоми́лостиве.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Ode 6. Heirmos:* Beholding the sea of life surging with the tempest of temptations, fleeing unto Thy calm haven, I cry unto Thee: Lead up my life from corruption, O Greatly Merciful One.[^7207]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Житїѐ моѐ блꙋ́дно, дꙋша̀ моѧ̀ скве́рнава, и҆ живо́тъ ве́сь ѻ҆кала́ненъ, тѣ́ло же моѐ всѐ въ ѕлы́хъ лю́тѣ ѡ҆кала́хъ; тѣ́мже потщи́сѧ, Дѣ́во, помощѝ мнѣ̀.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion 1:* My manner of life is prodigal, my soul is defiled, and my whole life is miserable, and all my body have I grievously defiled in evil things; therefore make haste, O Virgin, to help me.[^7208]

items.verbatim_book_heading: TONE 6 :: On Tuesday at Compline, Tone 6
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Коне́цъ предста̀, и҆ не терплю̀ благи́хъ; со́вѣсть ѡ҆блича́етъ мѧ̀: предстоѧ́тъ бо мнѣ̀ дѣѧ́нїа лꙋка́ваѧ, и҆ житїа̀ блꙋ́дное, и҆ сꙋди́ща ᲂу҆жаса́юсѧ Сы́на твоегѡ̀, Чи́стаѧ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion 2:* The end stands before me, and I endure not good things; conscience convicts me: for deceitful deeds and a prodigal life confront me, and I am terrified of the judgment seat of thy Son, O Pure One.[^7209]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Сла́ва: Пло́ти моеѧ̀ разжѐже́нїе, рѣка̀ ѻ҆́гненна стра́шна и҆ неᲂу҆гаси́ма жде́тъ вои́стинꙋ, и҆ че́рвь несꙋсыпа́ѧй; но ᲂу҆гасѝ мнѣ̀ сїѧ̑ моли́твами твои́ми, Пречи́стаѧ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Glory...* A fiery river, dread and unquenchable, truly awaits the burning of my flesh, and the undying worm; but quench these for me by thy prayers, O All-Pure.[^7210]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: И҆ ны́нѣ: Ны́нѣ тре́петомъ ѡ҆держи́мъ є҆́смь Блага́ѧ, и҆ ᲂу҆жаса́юсѧ лꙋка́вагѡ ловле́нїа; пре́жде бо конца̀ хо́щетъ мѧ̀ тли́тель ᲂу҆би́ти, держа́ мѧ ꙗ҆́кѡ плѣне́на всего̀, и҆ на́га добродѣ́телей.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Both now...* Now am I seized with trembling, O Good One, and I am terrified of the snare of the deceitful one; for before the end the corrupter desires to slay me, holding me wholly as a captive and stripped of virtues.[^7211]

items.verbatim_book_heading: TONE 6 :: On Tuesday at Compline, Tone 6
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Сѣда́ленъ, Гла́съ ѕ҃. Оу҆пова́нїе и҆ стѣна̀, и҆ приста́нище лю́демъ твои̑мъ є҆сѝ Дѣ́во: и҆зъ тебє́ бо роди́сѧ безстра́стнѡ Спа́съ всѧ́ческихъ, и҆ спасѐ ᲂу҆пова́ющїѧ на тѧ̀. Є҆гѡ́же пла́каласѧ є҆сѝ твоегѡ̀ Сы́на при крестѣ̀, того̀ и҆ ны́нѣ молѝ: и҆зба́вити ѿ тлѝ всѧ̑ пою́щїѧ тѧ̀.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Sessional Hymn, Tone 6:* Hope and wall and haven art thou unto thy people, O Virgin: for from thee without passion was born the Savior of all, and He saved those that hope on thee. Whom thou didst bewail, Thine own Son at the Cross, Him do thou also now entreat: to deliver from corruption all who hymn thee.[^7213]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Пѣ́снь з҃. І҆рмо́съ. Росода́тельнꙋ ᲂу҆́бѡ пе́щь содѣ́ла А҆́гг҃лъ, преподо́бнымъ ѻ҆трокѡ́мъ, Халде́и же ѡ҆палѧ́ющее велѣ́нїе Бж҃їе, мꙋчи́телѧ ᲂу҆вѣща̀ вопи́ти: благослове́нъ є҆сѝ Бж҃е ѻ҆тє́цъ на́шихъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Ode 7. Heirmos:* The Angel made the furnace dewy for the holy youths, but the command of God, consuming the Chaldeans, persuaded the tyrant to cry: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers.[^7214]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Се́дмь седми́цею пла́мень разжжѐ мнѣ̀ страстьмѝ лꙋка́вый, и҆ любодѣѧ́ньми се́рдце моѐ всегда̀ ᲂу҆мерщвлѧ́етъ; тѣ́мже то́ками мои́хъ сле́зъ ᲂу҆гасѝ є҆го̀, Ма́ти Бж҃їа, и҆ спасѝ мѧ̀.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion 1:* Sevenfold did the deceitful one kindle the flame for me with passions, and with fornications he ever slays my heart; therefore with the streams of my tears quench it, O Mother of God, and save me.[^7215]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Пѣ́снь и҃. І҆рмо́съ. И҆зъ пла́мене преподо́бнымъ ро́сꙋ и҆сточи́лъ є҆сѝ, и҆ пра́веднагѡ же́ртвꙋ и҆ водꙋ̀ попали́лъ є҆сѝ: всѧ̑ бо твори́ши Хрⷭ҇тѐ то́кмѡ є҆́же хотѣ́ти; тѧ̀ превозно́симъ во всѧ̑ вѣ́ки.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Ode 8. Heirmos:* From the flame Thou didst pour forth dew for the holy ones, and didst consume the sacrifice of the righteous one and the water: for Thou, O Christ, dost do all things merely by willing them; Thee do we supremely exalt unto all ages.[^7219]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ꙗ҆́же ѿ Трⷪ҇цы є҆ди́наго Бг҃а ро́ждшаѧ, и҆ на рꙋкꙋ̀ носи́вшаѧ, Дѣвома́ти, ᲂу҆гасѝ страсте́й ѻ҆гнепа́льнꙋю пе́щь, и҆ сле́зными то́ки ѡ҆мы́й дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Сла́ва: Стена́нїа немѡ́лчнаѧ, Влады́чице да́рꙋй мнѣ̀, и҆ сле́зъ тꙋ́чи да́ждь, да ѡ҆мы́ю моѧ̑ прегрѣше́нїа мнѡ́гаѧ, и҆ неисцѣ́льныѧ ꙗ҆́звы, ꙗ҆́ко да ᲂу҆лꙋчꙋ̀ жи́знь вѣ́чнꙋю.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Glory...* Unceasing groanings grant me, O Sovereign Lady, and give showers of tears, that I may wash away my many transgressions and incurable wounds, that I may obtain eternal life.[^7222]

items.verbatim_book_heading: TONE 6 :: On Tuesday at Compline, Tone 6
items.slavonic_diplomatic: И҆ ны́нѣ: Ѕѡ́лъ мои́хъ мно́жество тебѣ̀ и҆сповѣ́дахъ Влады́чице, ꙗ҆́ко ни є҆ди́нъ въ мíрѣ и҆́нъ прогнѣ́ва та́кѡ Бг҃а, Сы́на и҆ Гдⷭ҇а твоего̀: сегѡ̀ мнѣ̀ на ми́лость вско́рѣ премѣнѝ, Дѣ́во.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Both now...* The multitude of my evils have I confessed unto thee, O Sovereign Lady, for none other in the world has so angered God, thy Son and Lord: change Him quickly unto mercy toward me, O Virgin.[^7223]

items.verbatim_book_heading: TONE 6 :: On Tuesday at Compline, Tone 6
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Пѣ́снь ѳ҃. І҆рмо́съ. Бг҃а человѣ́кѡмъ невозмо́жно ви́дѣти, на него́же не смѣ́ютъ чи́ни А҆́гг҃лстїи взира́ти; тобо́ю же Всечи́стаѧ ꙗ҆ви́сѧ человѣ́кѡмъ, Сло́во воплоще́нно; є҆го́же велича́юще съ небе́сными во́и, тѧ̀ ᲂу҆блажа́емъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Ode 9. Heirmos:* It is impossible for men to see God, upon Whom the ranks of Angels dare not gaze; but through thee, O All-Pure, the Word Incarnate appeared unto men; Whom magnifying with the heavenly hosts, we call thee blessed.[^7224]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Сѐ прихождꙋ̀ тебѣ̀ Пречи́стаѧ, съ стра́хомъ мно́гимъ и҆ любо́вїю, крѣ́пость вѣ́дый мно́гїѧ моли́твы твоеѧ̀ ра́бъ тво́й: мно́гѡ бо мо́жетъ вои́стинꙋ Влады́чице, молба̀ ма́терна къ Сы́нꙋ; милосе́рдїемъ бо приклонѧ́етсѧ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion 1:* Lo, I come unto thee, O All-Pure, with great fear and love, knowing the might of thy manifold prayer, I thy servant: for a mother's prayer unto the Son can truly do much, O Sovereign Lady; for He is inclined by tender mercy.[^7225]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: По а҃-мъ стїхосло́вїи, сѣда́льны кре́стны, Гла́съ ѕ҃.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Sessional Hymn 1:* Thy Cross, O Lord, is sanctified; for thereby healings come unto those who are infirm with sins. Therefore we fall down before Thee: have mercy on us.[^7230]

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the First Stichology, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 6:*
items.preceding_stichos: Verse: Exalt ye the Lord our God, and worship at the footstool of His feet, for He is holy.*[^7231]
items.slavonic_diplomatic: То́кмѡ водрꙋзи́сѧ дре́во Хрⷭ҇тѐ креста̀ твоегѡ̀, ѡ҆снова́нїа поколеба́шасѧ сме́рти, Гдⷭ҇и: є҆го́же бо пожрѐ любо́вїю а҆́дъ, ѿпꙋстѝ трепещѧ̀; показа́лъ є҆сѝ на́мъ спасе́нїе твоѐ Ст҃ы́й, и҆ славосло́вимъ тѧ̀ Сы́не Бж҃їй: поми́лꙋй на́съ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Sessional Hymn 2:* Only was the wood of Thy Cross set up, O Christ, and the foundations of death were shaken, O Lord: for him whom hades had swallowed with desire, it released trembling; Thou hast shown us Thy salvation, O Holy One, and we glorify Thee, O Son of God: have mercy on us.[^7232]

items.verbatim_book_heading: TONE 6 :: On Tuesday at Compline, Tone 6
items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the First Stichology, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 6:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: На дре́вѣ зрѧ́щи ме́ртва повѣ́шена Бг҃а Дѣ́ва, є҆го́же родѝ пло́тїю, рыда́ющи зова́ше: неизрече́нномꙋ долготерпѣ́нїю твоемꙋ̀, Сы́не, ᲂу҆дивла́юсѧ. Ка́кѡ тѧ̀ беззако́ннїи ꙗ҆́кѡ ѡ҆сꙋжде́нна къ крестꙋ̀ пригвозди́ша пра́веднаго сꙋдїю̀, и҆ є҆ди́наго Влады́кꙋ?
items.english_cohort_translation: Seeing God hanging dead upon the Tree, Whom in the flesh she bare, the Virgin weeping cried aloud: At Thine ineffable long-suffering, O Son, I marvel. How did the lawless nail Thee to the Cross as one condemned, Thee the righteous Judge and only Sovereign Master?

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Дне́сь проро́ческое и҆спо́лнисѧ сло́во: сѐ бо покланѧ́емсѧ на мѣ́стѣ, и҆дѣ́же стоѧ́стѣ нѡ́зѣ твоѝ Гдⷭ҇и: и҆ дре́ва спасе́нїа вкꙋси́вше, ѿ грѣхо́вныхъ страсте́й свобо́дꙋ ᲂу҆лꙋчи́хомъ, моли́твами Бцⷣы, є҆ди́не Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Sessional Hymn 1:* Today the prophetic word is fulfilled: for behold, we worship in the place where Thy feet stood, O Lord; and having tasted of the tree of salvation, we have obtained freedom from sinful passions, by the prayers of the Theotokos, O only Lover of mankind.[^7234]

items.preceding_stichos: Verse: But God is our King before the ages; He has wrought salvation in the midst of the earth.*[^7235]
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Гдⷭ҇и, ѡ҆сꙋди́ша тѧ̀ І҆ꙋде́и на сме́рть, жи́знь всѣ́хъ; и҆́же чермно́е мо́ре жезло́мъ проше́дшїи, къ крестꙋ̀ тѧ̀ прогвозди́ша; и҆ ѿ ка́мене ме́дъ сса́вшїи, же́лчь тебѣ̀ принесо́ша. Но во́лею претерпѣ́лъ є҆сѝ, да на́съ свободи́ши ѿ рабо́ты вра́жїа, Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е на́шъ, сла́ва тебѣ̀.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Sessional Hymn 2:* O Lord, the Jews condemned Thee unto death, the Life of all; they that passed through the Red Sea by the rod nailed Thee to the Cross; and they that sucked honey from the rock brought gall unto Thee. But of Thine own will Thou didst endure, that Thou mightest free us from the bondage of the enemy, O Christ our God: glory to Thee.[^7236]

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Second Stichology, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 6:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Страда́льческаѧ сопротивле́нїа на сꙋди́щи, мꙋчи́тельскїа ра̑ны на мꙋ́ченицѣхъ: и҆ стоѧ́хꙋ ли́ци безпло́тныхъ, по́чести держа́ще побѣ́ды; ᲂу҆диви́ша мꙋчи́телей и҆ царе́й Премꙋ́дрїи; низложи́ша престꙋ́пника и҆сповѣ́данїемъ Хрⷭ҇то́вымъ. Оу҆крѣпи́вый и҆́хъ Гдⷭ҇и, сла́ва тебѣ̀.
items.english_cohort_translation: The struggles of the sufferers before the tribunal, the wounds of the tyrants upon the martyrs: and the choirs of the bodiless stood by, holding the prizes of victory; the All-Wise confounded the tyrants and kings; they cast down the transgressor by the confession of Christ. O Lord Who didst strengthen them: glory to Thee.[^7238]

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Second Stichology, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 6:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Сла́ва: и҆ ны́нѣ: Крестобг҃оро́диченъ. Предстоѧ́щи ᲂу҆̀ креста̀ неискꙋсобра́чнаѧ Ма́ти, и҆зъ неѧ̀ Ро́ждшемꙋсѧ безъ сѣ́мене вопїѧ́ше: ѻ҆рꙋ́жїе се́рдце моѐ про́йде, ѽ Сы́не! не терпѧ́щи ви́сима на дре́вѣ тѧ̀ зрѣ́ти, є҆гѡ́же трепе́щꙋтъ всѧ́ческаѧ, ꙗ҆́кѡ созда́телѧ и҆ Бг҃а. Долготерпѣли́ве Гдⷭ҇и, сла́ва тебѣ̀.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Glory... Both now... Stavrotheotokion:* Standing by the Cross, the unwedded Mother cried aloud unto Him Who was born of her without seed: A sword has pierced my heart, O Son! unable to bear seeing Thee hanging upon the Tree, before Whom all creation trembles, as Creator and God. O long-suffering Lord, glory to Thee.[^7239]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: На крестѣ́ тѧ во́лею на́съ ра́ди пригвожде́на Хрⷭ҇тѐ, тва́рь ви́дѣвши, колеба́шесѧ стра́хомъ; со́лнце ве́сь помрачѝ свѣ́тъ; ка́менїе распаде́сѧ, и҆ це́ркве бж҃е́ственнаѧ завѣ́са раздра́сѧ, на ѡ҆бличе́нїе лю́тыхъ и҆ беззако́нныхъ є҆вре́й.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Sessional Hymn 1:* When creation saw Thee willingly nailed to the Cross for our sake, O Christ, it was shaken with fear; the sun wholly darkened its light; the rocks were rent, and the divine veil of the temple was torn in twain, for the conviction of the fierce and lawless Hebrews.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Дре́во принесѐ тлѣ́нїе въ Е҆де́мѣ родонача́льникꙋ; кре́стное же дре́во жи́знь процвѣтѐ на Ло́бнѣмъ мѣ́стѣ: и҆́бо попра́на бы́сть ѕло́ба вра́жїа, поми́лованъ же бы́сть пригвожде́нїемъ Хрⷭ҇то́вымъ А҆да́мъ, и҆ ѡ҆брѣ́те ра́й, вопїѧ̀: ѽ дре́во благослове́нное!
items.english_cohort_translation: *Sessional Hymn 2:* The tree brought corruption in Eden unto the first father; but the tree of the Cross blossomed forth life upon the Place of the Skull: for the malice of the enemy was trampled down, and Adam obtained mercy by the nailing of Christ, and found Paradise, crying aloud: O blessed tree![^7241]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Сла́ва: и҆ ны́нѣ: Крестобг҃оро́диченъ. Тебѐ ро́ждшаѧ Хрⷭ҇тѐ приснодѣ́ва О҆трокови́ца, на крестѣ̀ зрѧ́щи тѧ̀, на́съ ра́ди вознесе́наго, ᲂу҆ѧзвла́ше печа́ли ѻ҆рꙋ́жїемъ своѐ се́рдце и҆ дꙋ́шꙋ, и҆ пла́каше рыда́ющи ма́терски. Тоѧ̀ моли́твами поми́лꙋй на́съ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Glory... Both now... Stavrotheotokion:* Seeing Thee, O Christ, lifted up upon the Cross for our sake, the Ever-Virgin Maiden who gave Thee birth wounded her heart and soul with the sword of grief, and wept, lamenting with a mother's sorrow. By her supplications, have mercy on us.[^7242]

items.verbatim_book_heading: TONE 6 :: On Tuesday at Compline, Tone 6
items.preceding_stichos: Refrain: Glory, O Lord, to Thy Cross and Crucifixion.*[^7244]
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ты̀ дла̑ни просте́ръ на крестѣ̀, ѡ҆бѧ́лъ є҆сѝ Влады́ко ѿринове́нныѧ человѣ́ки, и҆ къ твоемꙋ̀ приве́лъ є҆сѝ О҆ц҃ꙋ̀, ꙗ҆́кѡ Сы́нъ возлю́бленъ, и҆ є҆диносꙋ́щенъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion 1:* Having stretched out Thy palms upon the Cross, O Master, Thou didst embrace cast-out men, and didst bring them unto Thine own Father, as His beloved Son and consubstantial with Him.[^7245]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ꙗ҆́кѡже а҆́гнецъ воздви́женъ бы́лъ є҆сѝ на кре́стъ Сло́ве, твоегѡ̀ ѻ҆вча́те и҆щѧ̀ заблꙋ́ждшагѡ; и҆ ѡ҆брѣ́тъ сочета́лъ є҆сѝ то̀ къ незаблꙋ́ждшымъ, І҆и҃се. Сла́ва держа́вѣ твое́й.
